name: swipe-row
title: Swipe Row
description: A list row with actions behind it; swipe far enough and the edge action takes over the row and runs.

perf.budget: The row and its actions move on the UI thread from three shared values; a dismissed row folds its height once. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The row still follows the finger, but opens, closes and dismisses without springs or the slide-away.
a11y.screenReader: The row is one element named by accessibilityLabel, with every action offered as a custom action.
a11y.touchTarget: Action buttons are 76 pt wide and as tall as the row.
